legend: The Hairy Hands of Dartmoor (Devon, England, 1910 road legend)
lines: Dartmoor, England, 1910. A lonely road crosses the wild moor.
One summer day, a doctor on a motorcycle crashes there.
Soon, drivers begin to report the same strange thing.
Suddenly, the steering wheel is wrenched out of their hands.
They say two huge, hairy hands grab it and pull them off the road.
An army officer was thrown from his bike, and claimed hands had gripped his.
A woman in a caravan, legend says, saw a shaggy hand crawl through her window.
Engineers blamed a bad bend, but drivers still tell the tale.
Was it a curse, or only a dangerous road?
Tonight, keep both hands on the wheel. Would you cross Dartmoor?
title: The Road Where Invisible Hands Grab the Steering Wheel #shorts
description:
On a lonely Dartmoor road in 1910, drivers began to say two hairy hands seized their steering wheels. A classic English road legend.
